scenes.text: This tutorial covers Python API and headless workflows. Run reproducible spaCR pipelines from Python or a shell without the desktop interface.
Open Python API and headless workflows from the spaCR section. Start from settings exported by the desktop app or construct a validated settings dictionary in Python.
In the main configuration area, select the pipeline entry point, source path, output path, worker count, and hardware options.

Before the full run, review the visible settings and use a preview or test mode when one is available. execute the pipeline in a terminal, notebook, scheduler, or remote job while preserving logs and settings.
When the workflow finishes, the project contains the same masks, measurements, databases, figures, and run records produced by the desktop app.
